ipa.curves.forward_curves.SwapZcCurveDefinition

Available as lseg.data.content.ipa.curves.forward_curves.SwapZcCurveDefinition.

Syntax

SwapZcCurveDefinition(
    *,
    index_name: str | None = None,
    index_tenors: list[str] = None,
    main_constituent_asset_class: AssetClass | None = None,
    risk_type: RiskType | None = None,
    currency: str | None = None,
    discounting_tenor: str | None = None,
    id: str | None = None,
    market_data_location: str | None = None,
    name: str | None = None,
    source: str | None = None,
    available_discounting_tenors: list[str] | None = None,
    available_tenors: list[str] | None = None,
    constituent_override_mode: ConstituentOverrideMode | None = None,
    ignore_existing_definition: bool | None = None,
    is_non_deliverable: bool | None = None,
    owner: str | None = None,
) -> None

Parameters

Parameter Type Required Default Description
index_name str | None No None
index_tenors list[str] No None
main_constituent_asset_class AssetClass | None No None
risk_type RiskType | None No None
currency str | None No None
discounting_tenor str | None No None
id str | None No None Id of the curve definition to get
market_data_location str | None No None
name str | None No None
source str | None No None
available_discounting_tenors list[str] | None No None The list of discounting tenors available when using a given interest rate curve. the values come from availabletenors list (e.g., '[ois, 1m, 3m, 6m, 1y]').
available_tenors list[str] | None No None The list of tenors which can be priced with curvedefinitions (e.g., '[ois, 1m, 3m, 6m, 1y]'
constituent_override_mode ConstituentOverrideMode | None No None The possible values are:
* replacedefinition: replace the default constituents by the user constituents
from the input request,
* mergewithdefinition: merge the default constituents and the user constituents
from the input request, the default value is 'replacedefinition'.
If the ignoreexistingdefinition is true, the constituentoverridemode is set
to replacedefinition.
ignore_existing_definition bool | None No None An indicator whether default definitions are used to get curve parameters and
constituents.
The possible values are:
* True: default definitions are not used (definitions and constituents must
be set in the request),
* False: default definitions are used.
is_non_deliverable bool | None No None An indicator whether the instrument is non-deliverable:
* True: the instrument is non-deliverable,
* False: the instrument is not non-deliverable.
This parameter may be used to specify the use of crosscurrencydefinitions made
of non-deliverable or deliverable instruments. When this parameters isn't
specified, the default crosscurrencydefinitions is used. This definition with
'isfallbackforfxcurvedefinition'=True is returned by the
crosscurrencydefinitions curve search.
owner str | None No None Uuid of the curve definition owner for none refinitiv curve
